subject: Redwood Inference - Procurement & Security Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference - Procurement & Security Next Steps

Thanks again for the time today, Ellen & Tom — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call recap:
- Main goal: pilot Redwood for customer-facing chat generation in Q2 (low-latency, predictable cost).
- Primary gating items: procurement approvals (PO vs card), security/compliance artifacts (SOC 2, DPA), and Marketplace availability for faster purchasing.

Procurement questions:
- Which payment path does Acme prefer for this pilot: corporate card or PO via AP? (PO timelines vs card are different; see timeline below)
- Would you consider buying via AWS Marketplace (we can support that) to speed procurement and reduce contracting overhead?

Security gating (what we can provide ASAP):
- SOC 2 Type II report (attached: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf)
- Redwood DPA (attached draft: Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx) — we can accept edits or execute your standard DPA
- We’ll fill out your security questionnaire once you send it; we can also share a pre-filled questionnaire for common controls.

Suggested timeline (high level):
- Feb 25: internal budget/approval check (your side)
- Mar 5: target PO issuance if PO path chosen
- Mar 8–12: onboarding & pilot start (assuming PO or Marketplace purchase)

Action items:
- Ellen/Tom: confirm procurement path (card vs PO) and whether Marketplace is acceptable
- Ellen: send security questionnaire or confirm you want our standard responses
- Rishi/Dylan: I’ve cc’d the internal owners for procurement and security — Rishi will coordinate contracting; Dylan will support integration details.

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min procurement-focused call if that helps move things faster.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Ellen Park <ellen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Procurement & Security Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few answers from our side: 

Procurement path:
- Prefer PO via our AP process for pilot purchases (card is only for one-off SaaS subscriptions under $5k). Our typical PO timeline: budget approval by Feb 25, PO issuance around Mar 3–7 depending on approvals.
- AWS Marketplace would be great if available — that often expedites procurement for us (we can provision quickly once Marketplace order is in place).

Security/compliance:
- Please send the SOC 2 report (I see it attached). We’ll need an executed DPA before we can start sending any production data — happy to review your draft; I’ll have legal take a look.
- I’m attaching our security questionnaire (we like to use this for pilots).

Open questions for you:
- Do you support SSO (SAML/Okta)? Our security team will ask about authentication and log retention.
- Any options for data residency? We prefer US-only for this pilot.

Timeline & next steps:
- We’ll aim to confirm budget by Feb 25.
- I’ll route your DPA to legal this week and get back with comments if any.
- Please return the completed security questionnaire (or a pre-filled copy) — that will speed review.

Thanks — can do a short procurement/security sync next Wed (Mar 3) if that works.

Best,
Ellen Park
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
ellen@acme.com | (212) 555-0114

[Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]

- Dylan: prepare a brief SSO/Data Residency note (SAML Okta support + US-region hosting options) so we can answer Ellen’s questions.
- I’ll draft a suggested procurement email we can send to Acme’s AP team that outlines PO vs Marketplace paths and timelines.

If Acme wants, I can join the Mar 3 procurement call.

-Rishi

Would love to schedule a 20-min procurement/security sync on Tue Mar 3 at 10am PT — does that work for you? If not, propose a time and I’ll get it on the calendar.

Thanks again — we’ll be ready to expedite the pilot once procurement & DPA are in place.
